improvements.description: Prevent duplicate phase runs when approval auto-dispatch and manual Board or CLI dispatch target the same task. Use a durable task-scoped lease so duplicate dispatch is rejected across restarts or multiple workers.
improvements.evidence: Reverse-engineering browser run double-started build-verifier after PR approval auto-dispatched and the Board dispatch button was clicked.
improvements.title: Add durable per-task dispatch lease

improvements.description: Integration should produce a concrete artifact state: PR URL, local patch artifact, or explicit transport/auth block. Do not allow Shipped from ambiguous local-only state.
improvements.evidence: External repo validation reached Shipped even though the disposable repo could not produce a real writable upstream PR artifact.
improvements.title: Define integration artifact contract before shipped

improvements.description: Before marking a task done, verify task workspace cleanliness: no unexpected untracked scratch files, implementation changes intentionally staged/committed/exported, and hygiene evidence attached.
improvements.evidence: Reverse-engineering run left an untracked _verify_test.py scratch file in the task workspace after shipping.
improvements.title: Add final workspace hygiene gate

improvements.description: Make quality gates isolate host pytest plugins and prefer workspace-local src imports. Capture the command and key env decisions in gate evidence.
improvements.evidence: Quality gates failed from host pytest plugin autoload and then imported installed MarkupSafe instead of the task workspace src package.
improvements.title: Normalize quality gate test environment

improvements.description: Wire agent_run_events into the API and CLI so builder backlog run show --full returns a real execution timeline with event type, tool name, timestamp, and compact output preview. This closes the gap between high-level metrics and actionable debugging data.
improvements.title: Expose agent run event timelines in builder backlog run show --full

improvements.description: Historical validation improvement. Verified on 2026-04-26 that implementation flow already avoids resuming across cwd boundaries and instead passes compact design context into the workspace run. Keep only until a status-mutation surface exists.
improvements.evidence: Resolved in current code: src/autonomous_agent_builder/orchestrator/orchestrator.py documents and enforces no resume across cwd boundaries for implementation.
improvements.title: Enforce SDK resume workspace cwd contract

improvements.description: Historical agent-quality improvement. Verified on 2026-04-26 that chat runs already persist tool_result, tool_error, and run_error events, and the logs lane reads them. Keep only until a status-mutation surface exists.
improvements.evidence: Resolved in current code: embedded/server/routes/agent.py appends tool_result and tool_error chat events, and cli/commands/logs.py includes them in the default log lanes.
improvements.title: Persist agent tool and error events for chat runs

improvements.description: Code-gen produced a Vite React scaffold with npm run lint calling eslint, but package dependencies did not include eslint, so lint fails even while tests and tsc pass.
improvements.evidence: In task worktree /var/folders/d4/n827kdgs5hl0dj940t7t6wm00000gn/T/aab-workspaces/5e633692-c98e-4fbf-8553-872e00b8aae1, npm test -- --run passed 32 tests and npx tsc --noEmit passed, but npm run lint failed with sh: eslint: command not found.
improvements.title: Generated React scaffold lint script must include ESLint dependency

improvements.description: When a user-shaped continuation prompt dispatches background work, the Agent chat history should record a terminal run_status and correlate to the dispatched run so logs analyze does not leave the chat turn looking indefinitely running.
improvements.evidence: Fixed by recording task_dispatched run_status for auto-dispatch chat turns and surfacing dispatch correlation in builder logs analyze; focused route and CLI regressions pass.
improvements.title: Record terminal status for dispatch-only chat turns
